detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Deadzone: Rogue - Operative Pack includes:

  • ‘Void King’ Suit Skin: Put on a unique full-body suit and helmet that make you look as sharp as you shoot, in solo or co-op mode.

  • ‘Void King’ Weapon Skin Set: Access the exclusive ‘Void King’ line of weapon cosmetics, available for every gun.

  • Lounge Upgrade: Deck out your ship with a new lounge area and lighting. The perfect place to unwind with your crew.

  • Jukebox Upgrade: Add a jukebox that plays over 15 original soundtracks from the game.

  • Gold Player Name: Shows up where it counts. Subtle? No. Deserved? Absolutely.

  • Nova Burst Player Emblem: A permanent emblem of bravery and camaraderie, displayed on your profile at all times.

Thank you all for your support of Deadzone: Rogue!
